entries.title: External workflow reliability
entries.notes: Manual Google reply publication is now a DURABLE state machine (migration 0015, hand-written + journal-only per the 0011+ idiom; applied to the integration scratch DB): replies gains publication_state (requested/authorized/sending/published/terminal/ambiguous/cancelled, CHECK), publication_attempts, publication_last_error_class (CHECK), reconcile_due_at + a partial sweep index; pre-0015 rows backfilled (published→published, publish_failed→terminal, approved→authorized). Machine wiring: approveReply/retryPublish → markPublicationAuthorized (approved fact, attempts reset); the job CLAIMS via markPublicationSending (guarded approved + authorized|sending → sending, attempts+1 — null claim = cancelled/racing = NO Google call); success → markPublished (state published + fact); terminal 4xx/connection-gone → markPublicationTerminal (no retry burn); retryable → markPublicationRetryQueued + rethrow (row stays approved for quarantine redrive); ambiguous non-final → rethrow (state stays sending, same-job retry re-claims); ambiguous final → markPublicationAmbiguous (class persisted + reconcile_due_at = now+15min — sweeps can finally FIND these rows; they were log-only before). POST-CALL RACE GUARD: after the Google call, the job re-reads — row purged by the disconnect cascade → return without marking (provider-visible reply has no local evidence; provider-side cleanup out of scope); publication_state=cancelled → return (disconnect won the race; local truth is cancelled). Disconnect cancellation end-to-end: review context now consumes integration.google_account.disconnected → cancelPublicationsForConnection → cancelPublications (bounded batches, one tx per batch: guarded publication_state IN (requested,authorized,sending) → cancelled + status → draft for re-approval + ONE review.reply.publication_cancelled fact per row, new identifier-only event with an activity consumer so the family satisfies the readiness rule). Policy cancellation = the 3.2 gate terminal deny (no side effect + audit — §6 revocation-between-enqueue-and-send proven through the gate for publish-reply). RECONCILE-BEFORE-RETRY: retryPublish on an ambiguous row first re-reads the provider — shown → atomic heal to published, NO re-enqueue, NO duplicate send; absent → normal re-approve + enqueue. NEW hourly-30min sweep reconcile-ambiguous-publications (keyset-bounded 500×10, per-row isolation, throw-on-failure like retention-sweep; bootstrap + schedule + both catalogues + jobEnqueueOptions; assertJobReadiness passes). GBP upsert-safety: retries never duplicate (encoded 3.3, re-proven). AI-draft invariant PROVEN (new no-auto-publish architecture test): addPublishJob callers confined to approveReply/retryPublish (both requireManager + property access), transitionReply forces draft → pending_approval → approved (no direct draft → approved even with aiGenerated=true — approval IS the human review; no auto-publish path exists). Deviations: markReplyPublishFailed use-case deleted (the job writes classified states directly — would be dead code); markPublicationRetryQueued preserves (not records) the retryable class — class for retryable-only failures lives in job logs; still_failed rows keep their reconcile_due_at (sweep re-reads every 30min until healed — no backoff specified); persisted 'requested' never written (approval writes authorized directly — documented reserved). Not claimed: provider-side cleanup of orphaned Google-visible replies (out of scope by design), operator surface for reconcile (BQC-7), stale disconnect comment (integration context off-limits). Slice not accepted — pending independent review.

entries.title: Relay, lease, ordering, and retention hardening
entries.notes: Lease lifecycle proven against real PostgreSQL (6 integration tests): claim (SKIP LOCKED — two concurrent relays claim disjoint batches), RENEW (new ownership-guarded renewLease — the relay renews the unprocessed remainder every 10 publishes, killing the mid-batch lease-loss race), reclaim (expired lease claimable by any relay), release (markPublished clears lease). TWO PRE-EXISTING LATENT BUGS FIXED in the claim path: the claim CTE's SET used relation-qualified column names (PG rejects → claim never worked on real PG — latent because the dispatcher is off) and raw driver rows (snake_case) were cast to camelCase so every mapped field was undefined; the rewrite qualifies RETURNING columns and maps honestly. Relay: host-scoped identity relay-<hostname>-<pid>; dispatch jobs now carry attempts:3 + exponential backoff + jitter (previously neither retried nor quarantined — 3.6's quarantine never engaged); relay-side payload pre-validation REMOVED — the dispatcher is the single validation authority (its 3.6 UnrecoverableError quarantines poison) — the re-claim busy loop is dead. Envelope preservation (content-free, no migration): occurredAt (payload), recordedAt (row created_at via epoch extraction), correlationId (adapter re-attaches post-validation — it was STRIPPED at insert before), causationId/sourceAggregateVersion (null today — no producer sets them; honest note), region const 'unscoped' (BQC-4 owns re-scoping); old 8-field envelopes still parse. Ordering DEFINED in the catalogue: per-aggregate chronological enqueue (created_at) + state-idempotent consumers + receipt fencing; NO global ordering, NO execution-order guarantee (dispatcher concurrency 20); aggregate-version fencing unimplemented (no family versions aggregates). Retention: outbox rule re-keyed created_at → published_at (an event unpublished 29d then published was deleted ~1d later); per-run drain bounded at 100 batches/rule with capped signal + resume next run; migration-comment drift (7d/90d vs code 30d/30d) documented, migrations untouched. Alert substrate (warn-only structured logs; BQC-7 owns dispatch): health-metrics gained claimedCount, oldestClaimedAgeMs, stalledLeaseCount (unexpired lease older than 2× duration), expiredLeaseCount now backed by findExpiredLeases (its first caller — bounded ≤1000 scan), quarantine count/oldest-age; domain-events + quarantine queues added to depth reads (route + worker); health-check job evaluates named thresholds (oldest unpublished >15min, stalled >0, quarantine >0, oldest quarantined >24h). Deviations: findExpiredLeases backs expiredLeaseCount (stalled uses sibling SQL — expired vs unexpired semantics); expiredLeaseCount is a bounded estimate, not an exact count. Not claimed: abort-based timeout cancellation (zombie-vs-retry — handlers idempotent), leasedAt-not-cleared pre-existing column behavior, index-predicate drift (BQC-5), real alert dispatch (BQC-7). Slice not accepted — pending independent review.

entries.title: Correct dispatcher and unknown-work behavior
entries.notes: Unknown-work and dispatcher behavior corrected per the §4 failure taxonomy. Unknown job at dispatch: warn+return (silent BullMQ COMPLETED) → error log + UnknownJobError thrown — burns attempts into the failure quarantine.
